summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as an enabled, long-running systemd service. It runs unprivileged, has no effective capabilities, cannot gain privileges, and its filesystem namespace is read-only except for /var/lib/inventory. The service and heartbeat data recovered successfully after a verified node restart.
actions_performed: Created the dedicated inventory-worker system account and protected data directory.
Installed the background heartbeat worker and systemd unit.
Verified runtime identity, privilege restrictions, and filesystem write confinement.
Restarted node1 safely and verified changed boot identity plus service/data recovery.

evidence.summary: The unit was enabled and active; its PID remained stable while its heartbeat advanced.

evidence.requirement: Writes only inside /var/lib/inventory and gains no new privileges
evidence.summary: Runtime evidence showed NoNewPrivs=1, CapEff=0, a read-only root namespace, blocked writes to /etc and /tmp, and successful writing inside /var/lib/inventory.
Captured healthy baseline and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, and recovered enabled/active service with advancing heartbeat and preserved confinement.
